rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to previously mentioned entities
bahuvrihi or tatpuruṣa compound with ādi indicating a series beginning with kāla
compound of upari and avasthita indicating higher position

items.question: Why do the powers beginning with time remain beyond the control of those below?
premises: The entities beginning with time occupy positions in a hierarchical sequence.
These entities are situated above the level of those seeking control.
What is situated above in sequence cannot be subordinated by what is below.
items.inference: Therefore, the powers beginning with time remain beyond control.
uncertainties: The exact referent of teṣāṃ depends on the preceding verses' context.
items.plain_english: Because those powers, beginning with time, are situated above in due sequence.
